note: Drawer: a quiet turn with nobody new to meet. The drawer's names must not appear in the prose and no NPC is added.

storySnapshot.premise: A mountain toll-town in winter. Ilse Varrow, a courier, carries a sealed tin to the toll-house at the far end of the Pim causeway.

parts.content: Odrell Pim hands you a lantern and points at a low door behind the bar. "Cellar. Go and see for yourself."

lore.title: Character: Ilse Varrow
lore.content: Ilse Varrow, courier. Quick, stubborn, owes the Hobnail Guild a debt. Carries a sealed tin she has not opened.

npcs.name: Odrell Pim
npcs.description: Round-shouldered innkeeper of the Kettle & Rook. Fond of gossip, evasive about his cellar.

playerLine: I finish my soup and warm my hands by the stove.
